Measuring, fitting, cleaning & repair

Every published fee, in one place. Call-out distances are measured from Pinetown.

Measuring

Measure yourself: extra 10% off

Take your own measurements and send them to us for a free quote. Prefer us to measure? A cash call-out fee is paid to the consultant and refunded when you order.

Up to 30 kmR300
30 to 60 kmR400
60 to 90 kmR500

Self-measuring insurance (ask for it): 3% of the total of your blinds. We replace no more than 30% of the blinds on the order, for measuring out by no more than 60mm per blind. Without it, we’re not responsible for measuring mistakes.

Please check your blinds after fitting. Comebacks are charged as per call-out fees. Break something while fitting? Bring it in and we repair it free of charge.

How an order works

The whole transaction can happen by email or WhatsApp.

  1. ChoosePick the type and colour from the range. Samples on request.
  2. MeasureFollow the measuring guide yourself, or ask us to measure.
  3. QuoteSend your details by the form, WhatsApp or email. We send a free quote.
  4. OrderOnce you accept, an official order. After the deposit, a measurer checks your measurements in the Durban area.

Measuring in brief

  • Inside mount: needs at least 60mm depth in the sill (90mm for vertical blinds). Measure width and height three times and note the smallest; we subtract 10mm for clearance.
  • Outside mount: add at least 50mm to each side, top and bottom (100mm for vertical blinds).
  • Tiles or granite at the sill edge: cut-outs cost extra amount not published

Guarantee & returns

  • 3-year carry-in guarantee. Found a factory fault? Send us a photo. We tell you whether it goes to the factory or a technician can fix it on site (within 50km of our offices). Factory repairs are carried in to our offices.
  • All blinds undergo a double quality check.
  • Because every blind is custom-made, we don’t accept returns.

Since 1995

A family business, built on honesty, exceptional service and unbeatable prices.

It began in 1995 with cleaning and repairing blinds, then became an agent for top manufacturers, selling custom-made new blinds.

As authorised agents for multiple manufacturers in South Africa, we deliver blinds directly from the factory to any location in the country. All blinds sold fall under the manufacturers’ full guarantees, administered by Blind Specialist.

Customers shown on our Happy Customers page include University of Zululand and Air Products Pinetown.
